user_question: Count hospitals by census tract in Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Count hospitals by census tract in Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Convert hospital coordinates to point features
workflow_steps.purpose: Create spatial hospital point features from the longitude and latitude columns in the supplied table.
workflow_steps.instructions: Convert the supplied CSV table to a GeoPackage point layer using the observed LONGITUDE and LATITUDE fields. The source CRS must be explicitly confirmed at runtime; do not infer it if unavailable.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point coordinates to the known CRS of the census tract layer so the spatial count uses compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital point layer to EPSG:4326, matching the supplied census tract layer. Require runtime confirmation of the hospital points' source CRS before transformation.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Count hospital point features within each Centre County census tract polygon.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital points within each census tract polygon and preserve the tract attributes. Runtime QC must verify spatial coverage, compatible CRS, and valid geometries before execution. Leave the output count field name unset for runtime assignment.

requirements.scope: The source CRS of the hospital coordinate table must be explicitly known before CSV-to-points conversion.
The hospital input must contain the observed coordinate fields required to construct points.
The constructed hospital point layer must have a known source CRS before reprojection.
Hospital points and census tract polygons must use compatible CRSs for the spatial count.
Hospital points and census tract polygons must have valid non-empty geometries for point-in-polygon counting.
The hospital point layer must cover the census tract area being counted, specifically Centre County.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.
